title: Nyaya – Logic and Epistemology
short: Focuses on reasoning and valid knowledge.
description: Nyaya is the school of logic and epistemology in Hindu philosophy. It provides tools for reasoning and understanding truth using valid means of knowledge, called 'pramanas'.

title: Vaisheshika – Atomic Theory and Natural Laws
short: Explains the universe through atoms and categories.
description: Vaisheshika explains that the physical universe is made up of indivisible atoms (anu) and classifies reality into categories like substance, quality, activity, universality, and individuality.

title: Sankhya – Dualism of Purusha and Prakriti
short: Divides reality into consciousness and matter.
description: Sankhya is a dualistic philosophy that differentiates between Purusha (consciousness) and Prakriti (matter). Liberation occurs when the soul realizes its distinction from material nature.

title: Yoga – Path to Liberation
description: Yoga, based on Patanjali's Yoga Sutras, focuses on disciplining the body and mind to achieve liberation. It includes eight steps (Ashtanga Yoga) like meditation, ethics, and concentration.

title: Mimamsa – Rituals and Dharma
description: Mimamsa explains the significance of performing Vedic rituals and living according to dharma. It focuses on right action to maintain cosmic order and attain spiritual merit.

title: Vedanta – Ultimate Self-Knowledge
short: Explores the nature of the self and Brahman.
description: Vedanta, based on the Upanishads, Bhagavad Gita, and Brahma Sutras, teaches that the individual self (Atman) is one with the Supreme Reality (Brahman). Liberation comes from self-knowledge.
